Editor notes: See note to Mel 18.  The diameters of Mel 17 and Mel 18 were mistakenly transposed ny Melotte from the NGC, according to Raab and Collinder  (1931).  Melotte gave 7 arc minutes for Mel 17 aka NGC 1039, but it should be 30 arc minutes.  And vice-versa for Mel 18 aka NGC 1245.

Collinder  (1931) Cr 38 aka NGC 1245 note says: “Diameter and description confused by Melotte.” And refers to note in Collinder 31, which continues: ”As pointed out by Raab, Melotte evidently has confused the diameters and descriptions of NGC 1039 and 1245.”

Diameter derived from Melotte’s note: “The large extended cluster in Perseus, covering an area 5 degrees square.”  Trumpler (1930) gives an angular diameter of 240 arc minutes.  Collinder (1931) gives 220x180”
Hyades cluster diameter estimated. Trumpler (1930) gives 400 arc minutes angular diameter. Collinder (1931) gives 360x300 arc minutes.
Trumpler (p. 175, 1930): “The cluster Melotte 29 should undoubtedly be identified with this [NGC 1817] and not NGC 1807.”  Collinder (1931) includes both in his catalog as Cr 59 and Cr 60.
Diameter from note: “A few bright stars forming an extended cluster scattered over an area 1 degree square.  14, 16, 19 Aurigae are included.” Intended center of coordinates “16 Aurigae”
